card.title: Gracious Command
card.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

relationship.evidence: B2 expresses a real preference and B4 offers a constructive reduced-risk role.

heightening.evidence: B4 remaining division of work is verbally appreciated then removed at A5 as A takes the preferred books away.

specificity.evidence: A1 moving and book-versus-plate tasks establish the practical choices being constrained.
